name: Cafe zur Traube
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Café zur Traube in Tirol**

Discover the cozy charm of **Café zur Traube**, a beloved gem nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Since its founding in 1923, this historic café has been a meeting place for locals and travelers alike, offering a warm atmosphere where tradition meets modern comfort.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, fluffy and caramelized, served with fresh fruit compote or a dusting of powdered sugar. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** (Tyrolean alpine cheese) or a rich **Melange**—our signature coffee blend.

For lunch, savor hearty **Käsespätzle** (cheesy egg noodles) or a classic **Schlutzkrapfen** (spinach dumplings) with crispy bacon. Our seasonal menu also features fresh **Tiroler Speck** (smoked ham) and homemade **Apfelstrudel** (apple strudel) for dessert.

Relax in our sunlit courtyard or enjoy the view of the **Innsbrucker Alpen** (Innsbruck Alps) from our windows. Whether you're exploring **Innsbruck**, **Hall in Tirol**, or the surrounding countryside, **Café zur Traube** is the perfect spot to pause, recharge, and soak in the authentic flavors of **Tirol**.

**Prost!** We look forward to welcoming you.
